**The Sludge Hole** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

The Sludge Hole was an encampment owned by the Cutthroats, equipped with a Water Purifier. The Raiders used the purifier for self-supplying and traded water for Caps with other gangs. It was a profitable source of income, so long as the pumps worked. [1] 

The camp is set up along the shore of a small swamp. A military trunk containing valuable loot can be found in a northern tent. A tent full of yellow barrels with two notes and a Safe can be found in the middle of the camp.

The Sludge Hole appears in *Fallout 76*.
